newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wafangdian's B share offer price at least HK$2.
newsitem.headline: Wafangdian's B share offer price at least HK$2.

text.p: China's Wafangdian Bearing will launch an initial public offering of 130 million B shares in the first quarter of 1997 and list the equity on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, an official involved in the issue said on Tuesday.

The offer, which requires the final approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, would be priced at a minimum of HK$2 per share, an official at the China Southern Securities Co Ltd, the offer's main domestic underwriter, told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Wheelock Natwest Co Finance has been named as the issue's international coordinator, the official said.
Headquartered in the city of Wafangdian in northeastern Liaoning province, the firm specialises in manufacturing bearings for use in the automobile, railway and petrochemical sectors, she said.
The bearings maker aims to use funds raised from the offer to expand its core operations and upgrade production technology, she said.
The company has a total share capital of 209 million state shares and it expected to post a net profit of more than 100 million yuan for 1996, against an unaudited 80 million yuan in 1995, she said.
Nearly 90 percent of the firm's products were marketed domestically, with the remaining ten percent being exported to the United States, Southeast Asia and Africa.
Overseas sales in 1995 totalled about US$15 million, the official said, but did not give a comparative figure.
